children: Australia is likely to produce more grains and oilseeds in the 2026-27 harvest than initially expected, says Rabobank. It forecasts an annual crop of 63 million metric tons, "down just 8% from last year's strong harvest, which included record barley and canola volumes." It notes that ASX January 2027 and 2028 contract prices have recently fallen, albeit less than CBOT prices. An improvement in grain supply globally has been pressuring prices lower, it says.
